title: Identity token claims
description: The payload of the identity token (protocol 9.3). The token is a JWT. A service ignores each claim that it does not know (protocol 9.4). A schema cannot state some rules, for example that a token for a key has the claim owner. The tool access-token checks them. The member $defs.header describes the JOSE header (protocol 9.2).

iss.description: The edge that made the token. The configuration of the service names its value.

sub.description: The id of the subject: a person, or a key with the form key:local-part (protocol section 3). A PEP treats it as opaque text (protocol 3.3).

aud.description: The id of the service, or an array that holds it.

iat.description: The time of issue, in whole seconds since the Unix epoch.

exp.description: The end of the life of the token, in whole seconds since the Unix epoch.

owner.description: For a key, the id of its owner, which has no colon. It is for logs and for approvals. A service never uses it in a decision (protocol 9.5).

header.description: The JOSE header of the identity token (protocol 9.2). The algorithm is Ed25519 or ES256. The names none and EdDSA are not valid.

kid.description: The id of the key of the edge. It is mandatory when the key set of the edge holds more than one key (protocol 9.4).
